proposal.title: [983, 1050] Asset conversions
proposal.description:
This proposal swaps the 289,710.60 NTRN, 6,382,890.22 STARS and 50,952.45 stSTARS recovered from the static positions to BTC. Each swap has a minimum output of 50% of market value, the limit Proposal 1050 set. The BTC is returned to the community pool in a later proposal.

Following Proposal 983 (https://daodao.zone/dao/osmosis/proposals/983) and Proposal 1050 (https://daodao.zone/dao/osmosis/proposals/1050), this proposal also places sell orders on the Osmosis orderbooks, at current market prices, for the SubDAO's 11,491,872,415 PEPE, 3,012.49 LINK, 6,613,906,596 SHIB, 82,578.80 ARB and 55,090.59 OP, about $150,000 in total.

These markets have little or no buying interest on Osmosis, so the orders may take time to fill. Proceeds are received in USDC. As Proposal 983 sets out, the SHIB, ARB, OP and XRP proceeds are returned to the community pool as USDC. As Proposal 1050 sets out, the PEPE and LINK proceeds are converted to BTC and returned, and any PEPE or LINK unfilled after three months is cancelled and burned.

proposal.title: [1049] Withdraw Margined Positions
proposal.description:
Following the passage of Proposal 1049 (https://daodao.zone/dao/osmosis/proposals/1049), the community pool's Margined vault shares have been transferred to the Osmosis Liquidity SubDAO. This proposal redeems the shares for four of those vaults, returning the underlying assets to the SubDAO.

| Vault | Shares redeemed                   | Estimated return                          |
|-------|-----------------------------------|-------------------------------------------|
| 1252  | 3,569,321,921,678 lsd-vault-1252  | 4,676,729 OSMO + 225,441 stOSMO           |
| 1922  | 160,183,618,723 locust-vault-1922 | 1,062,278 OSMO + 1,137,998 bOSMO          |
| 1923  | 86,142,455,828 locust-vault-1923  | 2,332,760 OSMO + 69.57 ampOSMO            |
| 1982  | 8,530,121,655 locust-vault-1982   | 5.0092 allETH + 0.0160 allBTC + 39.8 OSMO |

Estimates are gross, before any vault performance fee. Per the governance mandate, the OSMO is burned, the liquid staking tokens are converted to OSMO and burned, and the ETH and BTC are returned to the community pool. Each of those steps will follow in separate SubDAO proposals.

proposal.title: [1021] Withdraw qOSMO Liquidity
proposal.description:
Following the passage of the governance proposal Withdraw qOSMO Liquidity for Redemption (https://daodao.zone/dao/osmosis/proposals/1021), the community pool's shares of the Margined Locust vault on Pool 1590 have been transferred to the Osmosis Liquidity SubDAO. The SubDAO now holds 55,254,561,906 locust-vault-1590 vault tokens, representing effectively the entire vault (99.998% of supply).

This proposal redeems those vault tokens for their underlying assets, returning the qOSMO (and any residual OSMO) held in the depegged, out-of-range Pool 1590 position to the SubDAO. The recovered qOSMO will be held by the SubDAO pending Quicksilver's resumption, at which point it will be redeemed, and the resulting OSMO returned to the community pool, per the governance mandate.
